title: docs(checklist-test): a verification re-run files no qa-run record; sweeps still file one per run
body:
Fixes #24127
Clause-②: no

Ruling-ref: 6230593290 (the maintainer's 「C 有问题才开卡 (Recommended)」, adopting the director's 口径 6229123659 items 1–4). Tier S governed surface (`.claude/**`): this PR stays draft until its contract-review record.

## What this changes

One file, `.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md`, in the three places the ruling names:

- **§4 (结果 issue).** The opening sentence now names the whole-round run (release candidate, area or `all`, maintainer-named target). It still files exactly one `qa-run` record per run, pass or fail alike, and it names §5's verification re-run as the one run that files none. This is ruling item 2; RUNNER.md's title grammar is unchanged.
- **§5 (收口, beside the three 重测触发).** Defines 「验证重测」 once: a run whose trigger is the same PR's ledger edit of that item (the edit §3 describes). It is not a fourth trigger and it files no `qa-run` record. The per-item table goes in the PR body, and the item's `history` row (`ref`) names the PR. A `partial` / `blocked` gap goes in the PR body and in the item's `fixtures.knownGaps`. A product-defect `fail` is extracted as today, its source line naming the PR. A stale-clause `fail` is fixed in the same diff. This is ruling item 1 with its sub-point.
- **Guardrails.** 「一个选择器、一次运行、一张 issue」 gains its complement 「验证重测不立 issue,证据进 PR 正文(§5)」.
- §5's health-signal sentence 「开着的 `qa-run` 数 = 未清的收口债」 is unchanged. It becomes true again by construction.

No gate, label or script is added.

## Reader check (ruling item 3, the card's confidence gap)

Measured at `bd4276a91` with `git grep -n qa-run`, reading every non-markdown hit:

- `scripts/qa/qa-rollup.mjs` fetches `GET /issues?labels=qa-run&state=all` (L762) and parses the canonical TITLE only (L269) into an area x latest-verdict x staleness matrix. It has no re-run category. A verification re-run that files no record is simply absent from it. Consequence, by design of the ruling: the roll-up's per-selector latest verdict is not refreshed by a verification re-run; that evidence lives in the item's `history` row and the PR body.
- `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` L3608 `H13_EXEMPT_LABELS` only exempts `qa-run` from the domain-without-pm-state flag. It counts nothing.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md` L16 excludes `qa-run` from the sweep.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/skills.md` L11 says a qa-run record is a protocol carrier, not work. It counts nothing.
- The remaining code hits are `qa-runner`, a spec/core family name, not the label.

No reader counts verification re-runs. The dispatch's RUNNER.md line numbers were stale: the record and label discipline sit at L460–L461 and L555 at `bd4276a91`.

## Line budget

- `.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md`: 238 → 238 lines (CEILINGS 238, headroom 0). Widest table row 221 → 221 (pin 221). No CEILINGS row moved, so no ruled raise is taken.
- The ruled text costs +4 lines (the §5 block, 3 lines plus a blank line). §4's opening and the Guardrails bullet carry their additions at +0.
- Paid by deleting content in the same sections, not by re-wrapping:
  - §4 label bullet: the drift narrative 「实测漂移形态:记录事后被补上 tests / tracking / bug,每一个都把协议载体推回排除清单本要挡住的 sweep」. Its two extra labels move into the ⛔ list. Its reason is already the bullet's own 「run 记录是协议载体、不入分诊 sweep」. −3 lines.
  - §4 title bullet: the restated fraction code span, now 「分数强制」 (the fraction stays visible in the title template). −1 line.
  - §4 opening: 「JSON 不进,截图不进」, already said by 「运行产物一概不进仓库树」 and the next paragraph. This makes room for the sweep enumeration at 3 → 3 lines.
- Every new line is within 120 bytes (largest 119 B).

## Verification (HEAD `296f877d0`)

Local subset, derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` after the final commit (16 families), plus the two the dispatch named. Exit codes captured before any pipe:

```text
node scripts/check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs :: exit 0
node scripts/check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs --self-test :: exit 0
node scripts/check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs :: exit 0
node scripts/pm/check-harness-current.mjs --self-test :: exit 0
pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions :: exit 0
pnpm check:agent-test-spelling :: exit 0

pnpm check:driver-memory-census :: exit 0
```

- `check:doc-formula-expressions` first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` were unbuilt). It was re-run after `turbo run build` for those two packages and exited 0. The exit 3 measured nothing.
- `check:pm-skill-ratchet`: 「.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md is 238 lines (ceiling 238; headroom 0)」 and 「widest table row is 221 bytes (pin 221; headroom 0)」.
- `--ran` reconciliation: 「16 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 16 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 16 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)」.
- No ablation: the diff changes no tested behaviour. `skip-changeset`: `.claude/**` publishes nothing.

## Acceptance notes

- Out of scope, reported and not edited (`domain:devx` text): three docs still say every completed run files a record. `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md` L460–L461 says "Every completed run — **pass or fail alike** — files **one GitHub issue** as its durable record". `docs/qa/platform-checklist/runs/README.md` L11 says "every completed run files one `qa-run` GitHub issue". `docs/qa/platform-checklist/README.md` L466–L467 says "every run files one `qa-run` GitHub issue as its record". Each needs the verification re-run exception.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- **改了什么:** 只改 `checklist-test` 技能一个文件。整轮测试(发版候选、整区或全量、你点名的目标)仍然每轮开一张 `qa-run` 记录。为验证清单修订而做的重测(验证重测)不再开记录：逐项结果写进 PR 正文,条目的 history 行指向这个 PR;没测全的缺口写进 PR 正文和条目的 knownGaps;真缺陷照常开缺陷卡。
- **为什么改:** 你裁决选了 C「有问题才开卡」。之前每次验证重测都开一张记录,一天开出几十张无用的卡,「开着的 qa-run 数」也就不再代表真实的收口债。
- **风险与代价(含回滚):** 读 `qa-run` 的工具(qa-rollup、分诊排除、半态检查)都已核过,没有一个统计验证重测,所以不受影响。代价是 qa-rollup 的「最新判定」不再反映验证重测,这部分证据在条目 history 和 PR 里。文件行数不变(238/238),不加门禁、标签或脚本。回滚就是还原这一个提交。RUNNER.md 等三份 devx 文档还写着「每次运行都开记录」,已作为范围外发现上报,本 PR 不改。
- **席位意见:** 
- **你要做的:** 无需操作。这是 Tier S 改动,由技能席位做合同级复核后落地。
